description: This file defines configuration structures and parsing logic for Talk Mode Gateway in an iOS application. It includes a data structure 'TalkModeGatewayConfigState' to hold configuration state, and a static 'parse' method in 'TalkModeGatewayConfigParser' to extract and process configuration data from a dictionary.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses configuration dictionary to produce a 'TalkModeGatewayConfigState' instance, extracting provider info, voice settings, model ID, output format, API key, and timeout settings.
